propositions: An optional, isolated adapter extracts Claude Code session transcripts using deterministic error-signature grep and regex-based classification, without LLM calls, emitting classified intervals tagged with source=backfill_classified and confidence=classified.
The adapter is quarantined behind a backfill script and must not be imported by the core metrics command or registry modules (portability guard enforced by unit test scanning source imports).

Candidate transcript lines matching error patterns (ModuleNotFoundError, ConnectionError, timed out, HTTP 429, etc.) are routed to one of five classification enum values (env_setup, dependency, integration, tooling, or none) via first-match deterministic routing.
The adapter module defines the classification enum with exactly the five required values and emits JSON records with schema {kind, signature, ts, source, confidence}.

Unit tests verify the adapter extracts and classifies a fixture JSONL transcript deterministically, a clean transcript yields zero records, the core metrics package does not import the adapter, and the backfill script successfully processes a fixture transcript directory.
